title.en: Acts No. 2094  An Act Providing that the Ten thousand Pesos Appropriated By Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Five as a Loan to Pay a Part of the Expenses of the Philippine Carnival Be Turned Over to the Philippine Exposition Board Created By Act Numbered Two thousand and Twenty-three.
title.orig: Acts No. 2094  An Act Providing that the Ten thousand Pesos Appropriated By Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Five as a Loan to Pay a Part of the Expenses of the Philippine Carnival Be Turned Over to the Philippine Exposition Board Created By Act Numbered Two thousand and Twenty-three.

text.en:
The ten thousand pesos appropriated by Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and fifty-five of the
Philippine Legislature, entitled "An Act making appropriations for sundry expenses of the Insular Government
for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and ten, and other designated periods," for the
payment of part of the expenses of the Philippine Carnival for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and ten, shall
be returned and allotted to the fund appropriated by section seven of Act Numbered Two thousand and
twenty-three of the Philippine Legislature, entitled "An Act to provide for an exposition of Philippine products
in the City of Manila, to appropriate funds therefor, and for other purposes," and may be disposed of in
addition to the fifty thousand pesos appropriated by said section and Act, for all purposes of said Act and in
the manner therein provided.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the same shall take effect on its
passage, in accordance with the provisions of section one of Act Numbered Nineteen hundred, and forty-five
of the Philippine Legislature.
Enacted, January 10, 1912.
